def clean(df):
    df = df.copy()
    # Drop exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    # Fix sex label variants and preserve missing
    df['sex'] = df['sex'].astype(str).str.lower()
    df.loc[df['sex'].isin(['nan', 'none', '']), 'sex'] = float('nan')
    # Convert body_mass_g text (with commas) to numeric
    df['body_mass_g'] = df['body_mass_g'].astype(str).str.replace(',', '').astype(float)
    # Fix flipper_length_mm: coerce to numeric and invalidate negatives / out-of-range
    df['flipper_length_mm'] = pd.to_numeric(df['flipper_length_mm'], errors='coerce')
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] < 170, 'flipper_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    df.loc[df['flipper_length_mm'] > 235, 'flipper_length_mm'] = float('nan')
    # Ensure year is numeric
    df['year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['year'], errors='coerce')
    return df

def answer(df):
    df = clean(df)
    df = df.dropna(subset=['species', 'body_mass_g'])
    result = df.groupby('species')['body_mass_g'].mean()
    return {str(k): float(v) for k, v in result.items()}
